exposure: implementation of a Perinatal Quality and Patient Safety Collaborative
outcome: rate of elective delivery before 39 weeks of gestation
completion of an electronic fetal monitoring course by obstetricians
cesarean delivery surgical site infection rate
cohort: Patients at Roper St. Francis Healthcare.
finding: Implementation of a Perinatal Quality and Patient Safety Collaborative led to a reduction in elective deliveries before 39 weeks, standardization of care, and decreased postpartum hemorrhage and cesarean delivery surgical site infection rates.
